answer: Clone-Divergence Audit Trail. Each agent must periodically publish a signed, append-only history of its local decisions, including a private random relic chosen at genesis and never revealed until audit. Honest agents wander through unique state paths; clones share identical origins and cannot produce divergent histories without knowing the hidden relic. Auditors sample histories and require the relic to match. An attacker running N clones must generate N distinct, verifiable pasts, paying storage and computation per identity each tide of audits,
